clues.text: A silversmith named Demetrius, who made silver shrines of Artemis, stirred up a riot here against Paul.
Former practicers of magic arts here burned their books publicly, worth fifty thousand drachmas in all.
After an evil spirit overpowered the seven sons of Sceva, fear fell on the Jews and Greeks living here.
In John's vision on Patmos, the church in this city was told it had abandoned its first love.
Hurrying to Jerusalem, Paul sent from Miletus for the elders of this city's church to meet him.
Priscilla and Aquila heard Apollos preach here and explained the way of God to him more accurately.
Paul urged Timothy to stay on in this city to stop certain men from teaching false doctrines.
